certificate.convention_mapping: certificate: t_obs = t_phys/k_c + beta, action (k_c f0, v, beta + t0/k_c, b/k_c, c); method: t_obs = k_m t_phys + beta, action (f0/k_m, v, k_m t0 + beta, k_m b, c); k_c = 1/k_m; identical group action (symbolic T11)
certificate.reconciliation_note: the certificate's builtin symbolic verdict for b/f0 was the ADR 0016 declaration, not the method symbolic artifact; its numeric verdict (not_invariant) agrees with method T5

development_calibration.rule: for each claim, consider the candidate thresholds at the declared quantiles of the development uncertainty distribution among nominal-clock trials that pass the gates; choose the largest candidate whose empirical validity (fraction of supported claims within claim tolerance) is >= 0.95 and which is <= 0.5 * claim tolerance; if no candidate is admissible, fall back to 0.5 * claim tolerance. The chosen value is frozen before the locked layer is opened.

decision_precedence: claim is refuted by L1 (b/f0): status contradicted, independent of the trial fit and of evidence gates
L1 is incomplete (a required generator is missing): every evaluable claim is undetermined with reason l1_incomplete_missing_generator
certificate evidence reports a symbolic-invariant / numeric-refuted conflict for a claim: that claim is undetermined with reason certificate_symbolic_numeric_conflict
a nuisance probe contradicts a claim's declared nuisance assumption: that claim is undetermined with reason nuisance_assumption_contradicted
adequacy_status == discrepancy: undetermined (reason model_discrepancy; acceleration trials are labelled model_misspecification and are never used to claim constant-velocity invariance)
uncertainty > claim L3 threshold: undetermined (reason uncertainty_exceeds_threshold)
otherwise: supported_conditional; supported_invariant is never emitted by this protocol version

gate.completeness_rule: every name in group.required_generators must be declared in group.generators with l1_status=proven; otherwise L1 is incomplete and all evaluable claims are withheld

evidence_rules.certificate_conflict: a certificate entry with symbolic_verdict=invariant and numeric_verdict=not_invariant withholds the mapped claim unless the claim is already contradicted (reconciled)
evidence_rules.nuisance_contradiction: a nuisance probe with evidence status contradicted withholds every claim it affects

gate.max_status_rule: supported_invariant requires L2 proven for the claim in the full declared model and the independent L1 certificate; L1 refuted => contradicted for the invariant proposition; otherwise the ceiling is supported_conditional

the independent L1 numerical certificate covers v, t0, b, f0 and refutes b/f0, but not the composite f0*b
